name: GC Biopharma Corp.
summary: GC Biopharma Corp. is a pharmaceutical enterprise primarily involved in the production and distribution of various medical products. Its extensive portfolio encompasses specialized treatments for blood-related conditions, non-prescription remedies, general medications, and immunizations, among other therapeutic solutions. The company was established on November 1, 1969, and its principal corporate offices are situated in Yongin, South Korea.
